purpose: FREE FABRIC v3 direct scheduled-compute proof plan
principle: ChatGPT hosted compute is primary. GitHub is durable state. CircleCI/Cloudflare are not in the primary path.

experiments.name: cross-run local disk persistence
experiments.goal: prove or falsify that one scheduled automation can recover exact files created by its previous run without Library, CI or provider traffic

experiments.name: cross-run workspace persistence
experiments.goal: prove preservation of directory tree, binary bytes, sqlite state, permissions and an unfinished work checkpoint

experiments.name: scheduled GitHub durable write
experiments.goal: prove that scheduled compute can publish machine evidence to the control branch without issue comments

experiments.name: continuation after restart
experiments.goal: phase A leaves a partially completed deterministic job; phase B must continue from the saved checkpoint instead of recomputing from zero

experiments.name: capability inventory
experiments.goal: measure actual local CPU, memory, disk, executables, browser, networking, process and filesystem capabilities without guessing
